requires.degrade: Without ctx7, /context7:lookup falls back to the Context7 MCP server when one is configured and otherwise cannot look anything up.
Without node, the ctx7 CLI (an npm package) cannot run and the bundled prerequisites checker only reports that node is missing; the Context7 MCP server still answers when it is configured.
Without CONTEXT7_API_KEY, lookups run anonymously at lower rate limits. The key stays in your environment: the plugin never stores, prints or logs it.
Without the Context7 MCP server, /context7:lookup uses the ctx7 CLI. The CLI alone is sufficient.
